title: WPMS/879/2013 of Audhyogik Evam Shaikshanik Sansthan Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 879 of 2013
Audhyogik Evam Shaikshanik Sansthan Ö Petitioner
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö Respondents
Mr. A.M. Saklani, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Mr. B.D. Pandey, learned Brief Holder, present for the State of Uttarakhand.
Honíble Kalyan Jyoti Sengupta, J. (Oral)
 In this writ petition, Collector, Dehradun arrayed as
a party/respondent.
 Learned lawyer for the petitioner shall take steps for
incorporating the name of the Collector, Dehradun in the
cause title by day after tomorrow, failing which, the writ
petition shall stand dismissed.
 The added respondent i.e. Collector concerned is
directed to take steps for demarcation of the land, said to have
been held by the petitioner, after serving notice to the
interested persons or officials.
 This exercise shall be completed within eight weeks
from the date of communication of this order. This disposes of
the writ petition.
 No order as to costs.
(K.J. Sengupta, J.)
25.04.2013
ASWAL
